mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as reduced discount rates increase equity valuations through lower cost of capital for corporations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 250 (CPIAUCSL) signals elevated inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy which reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS above 150,000) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 250) signals imminent Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to compressed equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000 and CPIAUCSL > 250, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In the late-cycle expansion regime (UNRATE below 4.0%), the S&P 500 tends to underperform over the next 60 days as economic overheating triggers Fed rate hikes and profit margin compression.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1250 thousand units (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1250, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 109.5 (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity, boosting corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 109.5, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: High residential sales (RSAFS above 500,000 million dollars) combined with strong housing starts (HOUST above 1250 thousand units) signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 500000 and HOUST > 1250, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns as tight labor markets support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0, or the Rank IC over 5 years is below 0.05.
